model.name: 3-immature-compartment Erlang maturation model
model.equations: dI1/dt = beta*A(t) - 3k I1; dIi/dt = 3k(I{i-1}-Ii) for i=2..3; dM/dt = 3k I3 - cM, with A(t) the fixed asexual driver in parasites/mL and M in gametocytes/mL.
model.driver_interpolation: piecewise-linear interpolation on the supplied arithmetic-scale asexual trajectory; values outside the range are held constant at the boundary values.
model.solver: SciPy solve_ivp with LSODA, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-10
model.observation_model: lognormal observation error for detected values; ND is left-censored below 2 gametocytes/mL via the lognormal CDF

diagnostics.alternative_model: 1-immature-compartment model had log-likelihood -579.53 and AIC 1167.07 versus -82.04 and 172.08 for the 3-compartment model.
diagnostics.identifiability: beta, maturation time, and clearance are partially confounded by the short profile and the single ND value; the mature half-life is better identified than the immature-chain shape.
